ones = [0] * 20
for i in range(1, 17):
    ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def count_ones(n, i):
    # Use as many i ones as possible
    times = i * (n // ones[i])
    n = n % ones[i]
    # If the number was complete
    if n == 0:
        return times
    # Decide whether to use one more of i ones to the subtract or not
    return times + min(i + count_ones(ones[i] - n, i - 1), count_ones(n, i - 1))
